transcript.text: I'm Leila, production management. I need to share something critical I confirmed this afternoon but haven't logged yet. The arena labor steward confirmed that the labor agreement requires exactly six arena stagehands, with a call from 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and it prohibits the touring crew from self-unloading the trucks. I received this confirmation after our daily production meeting, so it wasn't in the system when the draft plan was circulated. This directly affects the crew call — we can't just call a 'general stagehand crew,' we need exactly six arena stagehands on that specific call window, and trucking instructions need to account for the fact that touring crew can't unload themselves.
